Moe, Larry and Curly Joe circle the globe with Phileas Fogg III and his girlfriend.
programme.title: The Three Stooges Go Around the World in a Daze

programme.desc: Railway police take action when kidnappers choose their busy station as the drop-off point for their ransom money.
programme.title: Union Station

programme.desc: An ambulance driver and a nurse share an ill-fated romance in World War I Italy. Based on Ernest Hemingway's novel.
programme.title: A Farewell to Arms

programme.desc: A screenwriter (William Holden) daydreams with his new secretary (Audrey Hepburn) in Paris instead of meeting a producer's (Noel Coward) deadline.
programme.title: Paris When It Sizzles

programme.desc: A rancher's (John Wayne) wife (Maureen O'Hara) summons him home to hunt down the outlaw (Richard Boone) and gang who kidnapped his grandson.
programme.title: Big Jake

programme.desc: A playboy novelist's (Kirk Douglas) most businesslike secretary (Laraine Day) becomes his wife and literary rival.
programme.title: My Dear Secretary

programme.desc: A peace officer settles a quarrel between twins, the offspring of an American Indian mother and a white father.
programme.title: White Comanche

programme.desc: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.
programme.title: The Deadly Companions

programme.desc: An Indian (Burt Reynolds) resorts to killing to stop an outlaw (Aldo Sambrell) and his gang from killing.
programme.title: Navajo Joe

programme.desc: A brother (Fred Astaire) and sister (Jane Powell) take their act to 1947 London. Includes Astaire's famous dance on the ceiling.
programme.title: Royal Wedding

programme.desc: A Hollywood wheeler-dealer (William Watters) exploits a motorcycling rock 'n' roller (Arch Hall Jr.) new in town.
programme.title: Wild Guitar

programme.desc: Poor white tenant farmers (Zachary Scott, Betty Field, Beulah Bondi) battle fierce odds to make a living on a Texas plot.
programme.title: The Southerner

programme.desc: A traveling laborer teaches English to a group of German-speaking nuns while building a chapel for their community.
programme.title: Lilies of the Field

programme.desc: Seven children undertake the hazardous 2000-mile journey from Missouri to Oregon in the 1840s after their parents' death.
programme.title: Seven Alone

programme.desc: Upstarts challenge the fastest gun in the West, a haunted man (Gregory Peck) trying to escape his reputation.
programme.title: The Gunfighter

programme.desc: The poor orphan niece (Deanna Durbin) of a tycoon (Eugene Pallette) goes to a ball and meets a rich boyfriend (Robert Stack).
programme.title: First Love

programme.desc: A teenager (Tuesday Weld) wants to wear a strapless gown to the prom.
programme.title: Rock, Rock, Rock!

programme.desc: Controversial British officer T.E. Lawrence (Peter O'Toole) learns the culture of Arabs (Alec Guinness, Anthony Quinn) and unites their tribes against the Turks.
programme.title: Lawrence of Arabia

programme.desc: A federal agent finds a Nazi war criminal married to a judge's daughter and teaching and living in New England.
programme.title: The Stranger

programme.desc: Willie (Anne Baxter), a German woman, joins an American carnival passing through Munich. While traveling town to town, she joins Frank in his high-dive act, but tragedy is only a slip away.
programme.title: Carnival Story

programme.desc: A hard-drinking dockworker (Jean Gabin), who may have killed a man, tries to make a new life with a waitress (Ida Lupino) he saved from a suicide attempt.
programme.title: Moontide

programme.desc: A U.S. Cavalry officer (Audie Murphy) falls in love with a part-Indian missionary (Linda Lawson) in Arizona.
programme.title: Apache Rifles

programme.desc: A Los Angeles policeman (Van Heflin) has an affair and becomes obsessed with an all-night disc jockey's wife (Evelyn Keyes).
programme.title: The Prowler

programme.desc: Burlesque dancer Dixie Daisy is the prime suspect when rival dancers are found strangled with their own stage costumes. Aided by infatuated stand-up comic Biff Brannigan, Dixie must find the killer before she becomes his next victim.
programme.title: Lady of Burlesque

programme.desc: The new girlfriend in the architect's life finds foul play behind his bride's death and his own torment.
programme.title: The Second Woman

programme.desc: Sitting in a wheelchair, his leg in a cast, a photographer (James Stewart) spies on courtyard neighbors and sees a murder.
programme.title: Rear Window

programme.desc: A disturbed girl (Anne Baxter) with a heart condition moves in with her doctor and flirts with his married brother (Ralph Bellamy).
programme.title: Guest in the House

programme.desc: The sled dog Buck helps a roughneck (Charlton Heston) and his partner to cover a lot of territory in Alaska.
programme.title: Call of the Wild

programme.desc: An 1880s Brooklyn boy is summoned to England by his grandfather and raised as a lord.
programme.title: Little Lord Fauntleroy

programme.desc: Supercomputer HAL 9000 guides astronauts (Keir Dullea, Gary Lockwood, William Sylvester) on a trip to find the origins of humans.
programme.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey

programme.desc: Americans (Mark Stevens, Patric Knowles) try to smuggle gold from France to use against the British in the War of 1812.
programme.title: Mutiny

programme.desc: Capt. Jones (Anthony Hopkins), William Brewster (Richard Crenna), Priscilla Mullins (Jenny Agutter) and company have a rough trip on the Mayflower.
programme.title: Mayflower: The Pilgrims' Adventure

programme.desc: Brigham Young (Maurice Grandmaison) and a Mormon group face persecution as they look to settle.
programme.title: Savage Journey

programme.desc: The 16th U.S. president (Walter Huston) is portrayed as a lawyer, orator, husband and Civil War commander.
programme.title: Abraham Lincoln

programme.desc: An Indian teenager (Johnny Crawford) forms a bond with a horse, who saves his life.
programme.title: Indian Paint

programme.desc: Unwary houseguests meet their deaths when they are invited by an unknown host to a secluded mountain mansion.
programme.title: Ten Little Indians

programme.desc: An ex-racketeer's (Wendell Corey) abandoned wife (Evelyn Keyes) finds him in Honolulu, trying to beat a bum murder rap.
programme.title: Hell's Half Acre

programme.desc: Corrupt Wisconsin lumberman Jim Fallon travels to Northern California at the dawn of the 20th century in order to gain control of a tract of redwood forest. Fallon's underhanded tactics stir resentment from everyone.
programme.title: The Big Trees

programme.desc: A Broadway star (Bette Davis) takes a young and seemingly naive aspiring actress (Anne Baxter) under her wing.
programme.title: All About Eve

programme.desc: With an ambitious plan, a PR woman and a country-music bandleader turn a Texas truck driver into a rock 'n' roll star.
programme.title: Loving You

programme.desc: An American secret agent tries to retrieve a roll of microfilm in South Africa before it falls into communist hands.
programme.title: The Cape Town Affair

programme.desc: A woman (Lizabeth Scott) kills her husband and plots with a private eye (Dan Duryea) after someone tosses a moneybag into her car.
programme.title: Too Late for Tears

programme.desc: Mistaken identity spurs a foreign spy (James Mason) to pursue an innocent New Yorker (Cary Grant), all the way to Mount Rushmore.
programme.title: North by Northwest

programme.desc: Two shipwrecked stowaways (Bing Crosby, Bob Hope) ride a camel and meet a princess (Dorothy Lamour), whom they rescue from a desert chief.
programme.title: Road to Morocco

programme.desc: Corrupt Russian officials mistake a traveling buffoon (Danny Kaye) for the czar's dreaded inspector general.
programme.title: The Inspector General
